interviewers.name: Dana Whitfield
interviewers.title: Director of Systems Engineering
interviewers.notes: Direct, technically engaged. Came up through Navy programs. Asked follow-ups on architecture governance.

advancement_read.notes: Engaged throughout, took notes during the baseline migration story. Said 'we will be in touch about a panel' unprompted, but no date given.

stories_used.framing: Architecture baseline adoption on the uncrewed surface vessel prototype, framed around getting subsystem leads to buy in.
Incremental migration to a model-based requirements baseline, framed as risk management.
ConOps facilitation with government stakeholders - ran short on time, only gave the headline version.

gaps_surfaced.response_given: Honest answer that I have not worked a JADC2 program, bridged to multi-domain C4ISR integration covering the same technical problem.

salary_exchange.notes: Whitfield volunteered the working range without being asked. Sign-on component mentioned again as flexible.

what_i_said: Committed to the framing that my current prototype is pre-Milestone B and that I have not done flight or weapons systems. Said I could start four weeks after offer. Described the baseline migration as taking 'about a year' - stay consistent on that.
open_notes: Panel would likely include the chief architect and two subsystem leads. Whitfield raised architecture governance twice - prepare a stronger position on model change control before the panel.
